options.content:
## ${cwd:text}

**from:** `${__from:date:iso}`  
**as_of:** `${__to:date:iso}`

KPI include completed turns only and stay unset while no project is selected. For a repeatable snapshot, select an **absolute** dashboard time range; auto-refresh remains 10s but the bounds do not move.

**Project cwd is exact:** a Codex worktree is a separate cwd and is not merged with the saved project by folder name.

**Coverage:** explicit terminal, legacy completion, and missing outcome are separate. Dispatch failure means `event.success=false`; shell exit status remains unavailable unless instrumentation exports safe `process.exit_code` or `process.success`.

options.content:
### Optional agent contract

Gray/no rows means **unavailable**, not zero agents. This dashboard shows only observed v1 lifecycle records. Use the report for canonical interval unions, validation warnings, and partial/cyclic topology; no tree is rendered here.

panels.title: Agent execution KPIs (observed v1)
panels.description: Distinct opaque agent and delegation IDs from supported lifecycle records. Failed/interrupted requires an explicit complete status; an observed agent without one is unclassified. Wait share is intentionally report-only because this panel cannot calculate interval unions authoritatively.

targets.query: ({ span.cwd = "${cwd:regex}" } && { name = "codex.agent.lifecycle" && span."codex.agent.signal_version" = 1 }) | { name = "codex.agent.lifecycle" && span."codex.agent.signal_version" = 1 } | select(span."codex.agent.instance_id", span."codex.agent.delegation_id", span."codex.agent.delegation_depth", span."codex.agent.lifecycle", span."codex.agent.status")

targets.expression: WITH agents AS (SELECT traceIdHidden, `span.codex.agent.instance_id` AS agent_id, MAX(`span.codex.agent.delegation_id`) AS delegation_id, MAX(`span.codex.agent.delegation_depth`) AS depth, MAX(CASE WHEN `span.codex.agent.lifecycle` = 'complete' AND `span.codex.agent.status` IN ('failed', 'interrupted') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, MAX(CASE WHEN `span.codex.agent.lifecycle` = 'complete' AND `span.codex.agent.status` = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed FROM A WHERE `span.codex.agent.instance_id` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY traceIdHidden, `span.codex.agent.instance_id`) SELECT COUNT(*) AS Agents, COUNT(DISTINCT delegation_id) AS Delegations, SUM(failed) AS `Failed / interrupted`, SUM(CASE WHEN completed = 0 AND failed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Unclassified, MAX(depth) AS `Maximum depth` FROM agents

panels.description: Observed supported v1 lifecycle evidence in the selected project. A gray Unavailable value means no evidence, never zero agents; inspect the adjacent KPI table and report for partial coverage warnings.
